title: Conan source download cache left empty
description: global.conf declares an empty `download_cache` that re-fetches sources every time. Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads an empty `download_cache` that re-fetches sources every time.
remediation: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix an empty `download_cache` that re-fetches sources every time.
limitation: It matches an empty `download_cache` that re-fetches sources every time in the parsed global.conf; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
